figs.cap: Energetic relaxation pathways in artificial spin Ice structures . a Dipole and dumbbell model we have considered. The dumbbell model in particular considers the poles of the nanomagnet as separate entities. b Artificial spin ice structures will be primarily composed of either monotonic or intermittent energy relaxation pathways, dictated by the energetics of the intermediate states. A geometric example for each of the relaxation pathways is provided.

The interaction lengths dubbed “inside” and “outside” correspond to charges 2–4 and 2–3, respectively. c The interaction lengths are approximated as the arc lengths corresponding to individual nanomagnets as they transform at an angle of Ф . We find a geometric crossover for inside and outside interactions at Ф = 45°, assuming l = a.
